self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Primordial Jade Regalia (R1): for 3s after using an Elemental Burst or creating a shield (works off-field too), gain 0.3% Elemental DMG Bonus (of the wielder's own element) per 1,000 Max HP, up to 12% (reached at ~40,000 Max HP). Modeled at the 12% cap via all_dmg_, assuming a heavily HP-invested build keeps this window up often. The Energy restore (4.5 every 2.5s) is not modeled (non-combat/utility). Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: A ritual vessel carved from jade that reflects the luster of the skies and the clear waters.

refinements.1: For 3s after using an Elemental Burst or creating a shield, the equipping character can gain the Primordial Jade Regalia effect: Restore <r>4.5</r> Energy every 2.5s, and gain <r>0.3%</r> Elemental DMG Bonus for their corresponding Elemental Type for every 1,000 Max HP they possess, up to <r>12%</r>. Primordial Jade Regalia will still take effect even if the equipping character is not on the field.
refinements.2: For 3s after using an Elemental Burst or creating a shield, the equipping character can gain the Primordial Jade Regalia effect: Restore <r>5</r> Energy every 2.5s, and gain <r>0.5%</r> Elemental DMG Bonus for their corresponding Elemental Type for every 1,000 Max HP they possess, up to <r>20%</r>. Primordial Jade Regalia will still take effect even if the equipping character is not on the field.
refinements.3: For 3s after using an Elemental Burst or creating a shield, the equipping character can gain the Primordial Jade Regalia effect: Restore <r>5.5</r> Energy every 2.5s, and gain <r>0.7%</r> Elemental DMG Bonus for their corresponding Elemental Type for every 1,000 Max HP they possess, up to <r>28%</r>. Primordial Jade Regalia will still take effect even if the equipping character is not on the field.
refinements.4: For 3s after using an Elemental Burst or creating a shield, the equipping character can gain the Primordial Jade Regalia effect: Restore <r>6</r> Energy every 2.5s, and gain <r>0.9%</r> Elemental DMG Bonus for their corresponding Elemental Type for every 1,000 Max HP they possess, up to <r>36%</r>. Primordial Jade Regalia will still take effect even if the equipping character is not on the field.
refinements.5: For 3s after using an Elemental Burst or creating a shield, the equipping character can gain the Primordial Jade Regalia effect: Restore <r>6.5</r> Energy every 2.5s, and gain <r>1.1%</r> Elemental DMG Bonus for their corresponding Elemental Type for every 1,000 Max HP they possess, up to <r>44%</r>. Primordial Jade Regalia will still take effect even if the equipping character is not on the field.

fr.flavor: Un objet rituel sculpté dans du jade qui reflète l'éclat des cieux et des eaux claires.

refinements.1: Pendant 3 s après avoir utilisé un déchaînement élémentaire ou créé un bouclier, l'effet Tablette de jade primordial est accordé : restaure <r>4,5</r> pts d'énergie élémentaire toutes les 2,5 s et augmente le bonus de DGT de l'élément correspondant de <r>0,3 %</r> pour chaque tranche de 1 000 PV max que le personnage équipé de l'arme possède, cette augmentation pouvant atteindre jusqu'à <r>12 %</r>. L'effet Tablette de jade primordial peut être déclenché même lorsque le personnage fait partie de l'équipe mais n'est pas déployé.
